name: readability
description: Score English prose with Flesch Reading Ease and MTLD, and get rewrite guidance.
long_description: Adds an analyze_readability tool to Claude Desktop. Pass English prose and get Flesch Reading Ease (0-100), MTLD, TTR, sentence and word stats, and a complexity label. The analyzer runs locally and makes no network requests.

tools.name: analyze_readability
tools.description: Analyze English prose and return Flesch Reading Ease, MTLD, TTR, and surface stats.
